prompt:

Animation "attack":
1. next pose of the motion
2. next pose of the motion
3. next pose of the motion
4. next pose of the motion
5. next pose of the motion
6. next pose of the motion
7. next pose of the motion
Transparent background, no floor, no shadow.
No text, no numbers, no labels, no grid lines, no frame borders, no motion blur.
